concerns.location: tasks.md:T005 and 'Dependencies and requirement coverage' section
concerns.text: The coverage map claims 'SC-001/SC-003/SC-005: T005', but T005's deliverable and verification contain no statistical power analysis. SC-003 requires measuring whether 100 realizations per W achieve ≥80% power to detect slope deviation from -2 at α=0.05; T010 only reports 'power/representativeness limitations' as narrative. The SC-003 acceptance criterion is silently dropped — add a power-computation step (e.g., in stats.py with output to data/processed/) to T005 or a dedicated task.

Principle VI mandates that ill-conditioned eigenproblem instances 'MUST trigger a warning and be excluded from final scaling analyses.' T004 logs failed fits to warnings.json/skipped_realizations.json but nothing excludes high-residual (ill-conditioned) realizations from the regression inputs consumed by T005. Add an explicit exclusion filter (residual norm > NUMERICAL_RESIDUAL_THRESHOLD) feeding the SC-001 regression.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T002/T004 vs spec.md:FR-008 and Edge Cases
concerns.text: FR-008 and the spec's large-L edge case require handling L=1600 (sparse eigsh fallback). T002 implements the fallback, but no task ever runs L=1600 — T004's L_LIST per plan is {100,200,400,800}. The spec's large-L case is implemented but never exercised, leaving FR-008's acceptance unverified. Either add L=1600 to the exercised domain in T004/T009 or document the staging explicitly.
